scientific_integrity: An algebraic proof covers all positive integers in the claimed domain, with a separate exact finite corroboration; no independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only integers with at most two distinct prime factors are classified; the primality condition on the cofactor is not resolved for infinitely many exponents. OEIS lists the sufficient family already; new content is the unrestricted necessity in the specified prime-support layer. A prior unindexed equivalence cannot be ruled out.
title: Two-prime-support rigidity for the \(3/2\) divisor-sum equation
